phases.name: Phase Two: New Faces, New Worlds

movies.title: Captain America: The First Avenger
movies.synopsis: In the middle of World War II, frail Steve Rogers is transformed by the Super-Soldier Serum into Captain America. He leads the Howling Commandos against HYDRA and its leader, the Red Skull, before crash-landing in the Arctic and being frozen for decades.

movies.title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
movies.synopsis: In a retro-futuristic 1960s universe, Reed Richards, Sue Storm, Johnny Storm and Ben Grimm must balance family life with defending their world. Their cosmic powers are put to the ultimate test when Galactus, the Devourer of Worlds, and his herald Silver Surfer arrive.

movies.title: Captain Marvel
movies.synopsis: In 1995, Air Force pilot Carol Danvers crashes to Earth with no memory of her past, hunted by the Kree. Teaming up with a young Nick Fury and a shapeshifting Flerken, she unlocks the truth about who she is and becomes Captain Marvel.

movies.title: Iron Man
movies.synopsis: Billionaire weapons manufacturer Tony Stark is captured by terrorists and forced to build a weapon, instead constructing a suit of armor to escape. Back home, he refines the suit and announces to the world: 'I am Iron Man.'

movies.title: Iron Man 2
movies.synopsis: Tony Stark faces the shadow of his father's legacy and a dying body poisoned by his arc reactor. He contends with the vengeful Ivan Vanko, while S.H.I.E.L.D. keeps a close — and Black Widow-shaped — eye on him.

movies.title: The Incredible Hulk
movies.synopsis: On the run from the military, Bruce Banner seeks a cure for the gamma radiation that turns him into the Hulk. But when the monstrous Abomination threatens New York, Banner must choose whether to unleash the beast to save the city.

movies.title: Thor
movies.synopsis: The arrogant Asgardian prince Thor is banished to Earth by his father Odin and stripped of his powers. As his brother Loki schemes to seize the throne, Thor must prove himself worthy of Mjolnir to save both his realms.

movies.title: The Avengers
movies.synopsis: Nick Fury activates the Avengers Initiative when Loki steals the Tesseract and opens a wormhole over New York. Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow and Hawkeye must learn to fight as one to stop the Chitauri invasion.

movies.title: Iron Man 3
movies.synopsis: Haunted by PTSD from the Battle of New York, a suit-less Tony Stark hunts the terrorist known as the Mandarin. He must rely on his wits — and a homemade arsenal — to stop a threat that hits uncomfortably close to home.

movies.title: Thor: The Dark World
movies.synopsis: As the Dark Elves rise under Malekith to plunge the universe back into darkness, Thor must team up with his imprisoned brother Loki. An ancient weapon — the Aether — threatens reality itself when it bonds to Jane Foster.

movies.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
movies.synopsis: Steve Rogers discovers that S.H.I.E.L.D. has been infiltrated by HYDRA and must go on the run with Black Widow and the newly recruited Falcon. To stop the conspiracy, Cap must face a ghost from his past: the Winter Soldier.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
movies.synopsis: An outlaw named Star-Lord, a raccoon, a tree, a killer and a warrior — five galactic misfits — become unlikely heroes when they steal a Power Stone. To save the galaxy, they must stop the fanatic Ronan the Accuser.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
movies.synopsis: The Guardians meet Peter Quill's father, Ego, a living planet who offers him godlike power. As Star-Lord is torn between family and destiny, the rest of the team faces threats that reveal what the word 'family' really means.

movies.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
movies.synopsis: Tony Stark's attempt to build a global peacekeeping AI goes catastrophically wrong, birthing Ultron, a sentient robot determined to wipe out humanity. The Avengers — joined by new allies Vision and Scarlet Witch — must stop their own creation.

movies.title: Ant-Man
movies.synopsis: Master thief Scott Lang is recruited by Dr. Hank Pym to steal a shrinking suit and pull off the heist of a lifetime. With the power to shrink between sizes and command an army of ants, he becomes the size-changing hero Ant-Man.

movies.title: Captain America: Civil War
movies.synopsis: The Sokovia Accords split the Avengers over government oversight. Tony Stark hunts a rogue Captain America and his allies after the Winter Soldier is framed for a bombing, sparking an explosive confrontation between Earth's mightiest heroes.

movies.title: Black Widow
movies.synopsis: On the run after the events of Civil War, Natasha Romanoff confronts the ghosts of her Red Room past. She reunites with her makeshift family to take down the ruthless Taskmaster and the program that made her a killer.

movies.title: Black Panther
movies.synopsis: After his father's death, T'Challa returns to Wakanda to claim the throne, only to face Erik Killmonger, a challenger with a claim to power and a plan to weaponize vibranium. The King of Wakanda must choose between tradition and change.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
movies.synopsis: Fresh off his Avengers debut, Peter Parker wants to prove he's more than just a friendly neighborhood hero. Under Tony Stark's watchful eye, he tangles with the Vulture, a criminal smuggling advanced alien tech through Queens.

movies.title: Doctor Strange
movies.synopsis: Brilliant but arrogant neurosurgeon Stephen Strange loses the use of his hands and seeks a cure in a mysterious order of sorcerers. He becomes the Sorcerer Supreme's newest disciple and must defend Earth from the interdimensional Dormammu.

movies.title: Thor: Ragnarok
movies.synopsis: Imprisoned on the gladiator planet Sakaar, Thor must escape with the Hulk to return to Asgard. Awaiting him is his long-buried sister Hela, the Goddess of Death, determined to bring about Ragnarok — the end of Asgard itself.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp
movies.synopsis: Under house arrest, Scott Lang gets a second chance at heroics when Hank Pym and Hope van Dyne recruit him for a mission into the Quantum Realm. Together they must save Janet van Dyne while evading the phasing villain Ghost.

movies.title: Avengers: Infinity War
movies.synopsis: Thanos sets out to collect all six Infinity Stones and wipe out half the universe with a snap of his fingers. Every hero on Earth and across the stars must unite to stop him — but the Mad Titan is inevitable.

movies.title: Avengers: Endgame
movies.synopsis: Five years after the Snap, the surviving Avengers undertake a desperate time-heist to retrieve the Infinity Stones and reverse Thanos's destruction. The plan culminates in one last battle to save the universe and honor the fallen.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
movies.synopsis: Peter Parker just wants a school trip to Europe, but he's pulled back into heroics when elemental monsters attack. Recruited by a mysterious new hero named Mysterio, Peter must decide whether to carry on Iron Man's legacy.

movies.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
movies.synopsis: Master martial artist Shang-Chi is drawn back into the orbit of his father, the immortal warlord Wenwu wielding the Ten Rings. He must confront his past and claim his destiny to stop a mythic beast from being unleashed.

movies.title: Eternals
movies.synopsis: Ancient alien immortals who have secretly lived on Earth for 7,000 years must reunite after the Snap to face the Deviants. Their mission forces a reckoning with the true, unsettling purpose of their creation.

movies.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
movies.synopsis: After his identity is exposed, Peter Parker asks Doctor Strange to cast a spell that goes horribly wrong, tearing open the multiverse. Villains and heroes from other realities flood in, forcing Peter to make an impossible sacrifice.

movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.synopsis: Doctor Strange must protect America Chavez, a girl who can travel between universes, from a corrupted sorcerer. His journey across the multiverse pits him against the all-powerful Scarlet Witch, consumed by grief and madness.

movies.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
movies.synopsis: Thor reunites with his ex-girlfriend Jane Foster, who now wields a reconstructed Mjolnir as the Mighty Thor. Together they must stop Gorr the God Butcher, a nihilistic killer on a crusade to exterminate every god in the cosmos.

movies.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever
movies.synopsis: As Wakanda mourns King T'Challa, the nation is threatened by Namor, the mutant king of an underwater civilization. Queen Ramonda, Shuri and the Dora Milaje must defend their homeland against a war with the ocean.

movies.title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
movies.synopsis: Scott Lang, Hope van Dyne and the Pym family are accidentally pulled into the Quantum Realm. There they encounter the exiled conqueror Kang the Conqueror, a time-traveling warlord who could doom the entire multiverse if freed.

movies.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
movies.synopsis: Suffering a devastating loss, Rocket's mysterious past catches up with the Guardians. The team must travel across the cosmos to save their friend from the monstrous High Evolutionary, who experiments on living beings without mercy.

movies.title: The Marvels
movies.synopsis: When Carol Danvers' powers become entangled with those of Monica Rambeau and Kamala Khan, the three heroes swap places with every use of their abilities. They must team up to stop the Kree zealot Dar-Benn from tearing apart space.

movies.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
movies.synopsis: The TVA recruits Wade Wilson to save his dying universe, forcing him to drag a reluctant Wolverine out of retirement. The foul-mouthed duo must survive a showdown with the multiverse-devouring Cassandra Nova and reshape the future of the 20th Century Fox legacy.

movies.title: Captain America: Brave New World
movies.synopsis: Sam Wilson, the new Captain America, navigates a geopolitical crisis after President Thaddeus Ross is elected. When a plot involving adamantium, mind control and the monstrous Red Hulk unfolds, Sam must prove he is worthy of the shield.

movies.title: Thunderbolts*
movies.synopsis: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine assembles a crew of flawed government operatives and reformed villains — including the Winter Soldier, Yelena Belova, Red Guardian, Ghost and Taskmaster — for a mission that goes devastatingly wrong. The team that's not a team must face the monstrous Void.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.synopsis: With the world no longer knowing who Peter Parker is, Spider-Man starts a brand-new chapter balancing a fresh life, new allies and old enemies. The wall-crawler forges a bold new path as the multiverse closes in around him.

movies.title: Avengers: Doomsday
movies.synopsis: A new and terrifying threat emerges as Victor Von Doom — the brilliant, feared ruler of Battleworld — arrives to reshape reality. The scattered heroes of the MCU, from Doctor Strange to the Fantastic Four to a new generation of Avengers, must assemble for the beginning of the end of the Multiverse Saga.

movies.title: Avengers: Secret Wars
movies.synopsis: The final chapter of the Multiverse Saga: heroes and villains from across every reality collide in the patchwork world of Battleworld ruled by Doctor Doom. The Avengers, the X-Men, the Fantastic Four and Guardians from every universe must decide what is worth saving — and what the multiverse should become.
